Author: Ambuj Nath Bench: Ambuj Nath  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI  B.A No. 8317 of 2024  Uma Shankar Rajak, aged about 22 years, son of Bharat Rajak, resident of  Village-Hazipur Diyara, P.O Murzachauki, P.S. Muffasil, District Sahibganj  --- --- Petition  Versus  The State of Jharkhand --- --- Opp. Par  ---
CORAM: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath ---
For the Petitioner: Mr. Gautam Kumar, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Jitendra Pandey, A.P.P.

03 / 11.12.2024 Heard the parties.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Rajmahal P.S. Case No. 124 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 376, 120B, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 /
4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Rajmahal.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is a major lady.
Petitioner has obtained consent for physical relationship on the promise of marriage.
Thereafter, he refused to marry her.
4. It appears that the parties were in consensual physical relationship for more than a year.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Rajmahal in connection with Rajmahal P.S.
Case No. 124 of 2023.
